subject: FOLD long-context far-memory component probe for DFlash2
modifications: Reimplemented equations 1-4 as a dense NumPy oracle with no PyTorch, Triton, CUDA or vLLM dependency.

Added an MLX live attention path that preserves the ordinary DFlash2 target and verifier, exact local RoPE positions, position-free far queries, alpha-concentrated memory normalization and mass-weighted branch merging. Full-attention layers use the paper's row-varying local split; sliding layers retain their native exact window and add all older entries as far memory, matching the published plugin variant.

Added an adapter-owned full rotated K/V plus unrotated-K cache whose state, cache-operations contract, checkpoint-publication descriptors, byte accounting, trim boundary and route identity include the far-memory plane.

Used an fp32-reduction RMSNorm equivalent only on the selected FOLD drafter path because MLX 0.32.4's fused Metal RMSNorm crashed inside the long-context FOLD graph. Unit evidence binds it numerically to stock RMSNorm; the ordinary DFlash2 path is unchanged.
Kept the route explicit, revision-bound, default-off and unqualified. The Qwen3.8 candidate uses W=4096, alpha=2 and enables far memory on its five native sliding-attention layers.
